integrity: All finite claims are derived from an explicit 18-orbit certificate, exhaustive 32768-mask enumeration, and independent 512-state shortest-path verification; primary code construction is attributed to existing literature.
scientific_limitations: Exact finite Petersen cycle-code syndrome census only; no all-graph extension. A 1993 graph cycle-code covering-radius paper could not be read in full, and an unindexed equivalent older coset table cannot be excluded.
title: Exact coset-leader distance and tie enumerator of the binary Petersen cycle code
